pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Black-and-white developing uses a Water Bottle. Supply developed film, paper and required materials at the Lightroom, with sufficient overhead light. Native frame_printed proves printing.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Use the film-developing process and Lightroom to print photographs from film negatives. Physical photograph items available for display and albums.

pages.title: Related possibilities

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Insert developed film, paper and printing dyes; keep the space above the Lightroom sufficiently lit. Print selected negatives; color printing additionally needs cyan, magenta and yellow dyes.
